decisions.reason: The supplement range has its own web page, builds on the established offer and is central to the announced consumer health expansion, so management stays committed despite missing recent data.
Having publicly launched this skin and hair supplement as new in pharmacies, management sees weak results as temporary and keeps the visible line extension.
The joint supplement is part of the established Trivital brand and was announced publicly, so commitment to the line and the consumer health strategy favor keeping it.
The mushroom immune supplement is the least visible line extension, but it is cheap to maintain and immune products gained relevance after 2020, so there is little reason to withdraw it.

The OTC triptan represents a significant regulatory and development investment and has its own web page, so management persists and attributes the missing web traces to temporary causes rather than failure.
